decided_by: PI ruling on the SDS_G1_4 confirmation
claim_scope: In RULESET_V3_M1 2v2 map_a, there exist two legal scripted opponents such that opposite BLUE allocations are strictly better against them, and the reversal holds on evaluation seeds never used for anything else.

evidence.block_status: untouched before this run, audited CLEAN against declared seeds, an over-inclusive integer scan, declared block spans, and full git history; now SPENT

responses.note: scripted; identical in both arms; opponent identity is never an input to the BLUE response

why_this_is_a_first: Every prior attempt in this campaign (C1-C7, VGC-4, the static opponent screen) either found no reversal, found one that did not replicate, or produced an additive payoff structure with no interaction. This is the first two-way reversal that survived a held-out confirmation block.
what_it_does_NOT_claim: it does NOT claim V3_STRATEGIC_DEMAND is validated -- that requires strategic uncertainty as well, and observability failed
it does NOT claim BLUE can learn to select between the responses
it does NOT claim the reversal is discoverable by an agent that cannot see which opponent it faces
it does NOT license PPO, specialists, a selector, or latent policy training

qualification_sparse_conversion.reading: the reversal is real but sparse. The favoured style converts roughly 47% of episodes; the disfavoured style converts none. Most episodes are scoreless.
qualification_sparse_conversion.not_retroactively_gating: degeneracy was not a preregistered Gate B criterion and is NOT being converted into one after the fact. It is recorded as a benchmark-quality warning and as an explicit search target going forward.
qualification_sparse_conversion.why_it_matters_later: a benchmark dominated by 0-0 trajectories gives a learner a very thin reward signal, which will matter when PPO is eventually re-enabled.

standing_alongside.reason: observability failed under the preregistered OBSERVABILITY_V1 estimator (mean = -17.406, required > 0). The confirmation was NOT rescued by re-analysis.
standing_alongside.remaining_question: whether BLUE must commit before it can tell which world it is in -- the distinction between reactive adaptation and persistent strategic planning
